_comment: The Decide Together rules. This is the most product-critical file in the repo: it encodes how a pod turns a
loose idea into an agreed plan, and the fairness guarantees that make members willing to vote honestly.
THE NON-NEGOTIABLE RULE: no member ever sees anybody's stance, or the aggregate, before every member has
responded. The swipe queue shows only the proposal. This prevents bandwagoning, and the API enforces it by
stripping vote data from responses while an idea is still in the 'deciding' stage.
idea created (creator pre-votes, so they never swipe their own)
-> everyone_in   : becomes a real Plan / Trip immediately
-> work_it_out   : divided; opens compromise negotiation with an AI proposal
-> maybe_later   : interesting but the pod is not ready
harmony = ((want + maybe*0.5) / total) * 100 - (no / total) * 15, then adjusted and clamped to 0..100.
A 'maybe' counts as half support because it is genuine partial interest, not an abstention. A 'no' costs an
extra 15-point-weighted penalty on top of contributing nothing, because one person actively opposed is worth
more than one person merely absent when deciding whether a plan is worth pushing.

creatorWantedBonus.why: The proposer being enthusiastic is a small positive signal about how likely the plan is to actually happen.

aiSourcePenalty.why: A machine suggestion is ranked slightly below a human's at equal support, so the pod's own ideas surface first.

_comment: Evaluated in this exact order once every member has voted. Order is load-bearing: 'everyone_in' must be
checked before the 'no' majority rule, and the maybe rule before the fallback.

order.why: Unanimous enthusiasm. Becomes a real plan with no further negotiation.
At least half actively oppose it and opposition outweighs support. Archived. Uses ceil so a 3-member pod needs 2 objections, not 1.5.

order.condition: maybe >= want AND maybe >= no AND want < total
order.why: Lukewarm across the board. Nobody is against it, but there is not enough energy to plan it now.
Genuinely divided -- real support and real opposition coexist. This is the only outcome that opens the compromise flow.

stageMapping._comment: Outcome to pipeline stage. 'considering' is the Work It Out bucket. The legacy stages 'discussing' and 'becoming_real' both collapse to 'planned': once a pod agrees, the idea becomes a Plan in the unified list and there is no separate planning-together stage.

work_it_out.label: Your Pod isn't fully aligned yet
work_it_out.line: Can you make this work for everyone?

maybe_later.label: Maybe later
maybe_later.line: Interesting idea -- but the Pod isn't ready to plan it yet.

not_for_us.label: Not for us
not_for_us.line: Not enough interest -- saved to the archive.

deciding.label: Deciding together
deciding.line: Everyone gets a chance to respond.

boardSections.label: Work it out
boardSections.blurb: You're divided -- let's find a compromise.

compromiseFallbacks._comment: Used when no AI provider is configured, or when the provider call fails. Generated from the idea's own shape so the suggestions are still specific rather than generic filler.
generic: Replace the part that doesn't fit

aiSuggestionInterleave._comment: Peapod's own suggestions are mixed evenly into the swipe queue rather than batched, so the pod never hits a run of machine ideas in a row.
